The '''Anarrians''' were a [[Near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that evolved on the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altiria/Anarris]]. They were a militaristic species, placing great importance on the strength of one's body and on the physical aspects of life. By refining themselves through combat and physical development, Anarrians strove to achieve perfection and a higher status in life. They were locked in a perpetual war with the other [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species on the planet, the [[Altiri/Legends|Altiri]], and they felt it was the perfect testing ground for their beliefs.<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />

Most Anarrians spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] in addition to [[Anarrese|their native tongue]].<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />

==Biology and appearance==
Anarrians' bodies were covered in fur that varied in color from light blonde to dark brown. They had long, pointed ears, and a ridge of small horns crossed their face above the brow. Anarrians were on average 1.8 meters in height and had a maturity rate slightly greater than that of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] but a shorter life span.<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />
